name: current-3d-engineering
description: Current-source 3D and graphics engineering for ChatGPT and Codex across arbitrary project languages, runtimes, engines, toolchains, and target platforms.

interface.longDescription: Inspects the actual project, discovers dependency provenance and toolchain/runtime ownership, verifies current authoritative API and compatibility information, and implements or reviews 3D/graphics software without predefined language, engine, package-manager, or project-type support lists.
defaultPrompt: Use Current 3D Engineering to implement this 3D feature against the architecture, toolchain, and dependencies already in my project.
Use Current 3D Engineering to diagnose this graphics issue using current authoritative sources appropriate to my project.
Use Current 3D Engineering to verify and safely change the dependencies, SDKs, toolchains, or runtime components involved in this 3D work.
